messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for service=kv-cache severity=high. spike in continuous-batching misses and tool/function-call 5xxs starting at ~1778754200. affected route: /v1/generate (tool_call enabled). auto-escalation to on-call.
ryan_oncall: I'm on it. seeing ~40% 5xx from toolcall handlers and large KV cache eviction spikes. pulling traces now.
maya_dev: i shipped the structured-output change (serializer v2) ~9m before pager. it changes how tool responses are nested, might increase per-token variability. rolling back if needed.
alana_sre: thanks ryan. can you snapshot kv-cache metrics (evictions, per-key sizes) and QPS? also add a flame graph from the runtime for toolcall path.
infra_paul: grabbing metrics: `curl -s http://metrics.internal/kvcache | jq '.evictions, .entries, .avg_entry_size'`
ryan_oncall: logs: `ERROR tool_call_handler: failed to apply batch - kv_prefix mismatch, key not found` repeating. looks like batch composition is breaking when tool outputs contain nested arrays.
maya_dev: that makes sense — serializer v2 emits compact arrays for arguments sometimes, which changed chunk boundaries. continuous-batching expects stable prefixable tokens.
ryan_oncall: immediate mitigation: reducing max_batch_size for /v1/generate to 1 for routes where `tool_call` present. updating runtime config now. command: ```PATCH /config/batching {"route":"/v1/generate","conditions":{"tool_call":true},"max_batch_size":1}```
deploy-bot: config PATCH accepted, rollout started. canary 3/3 hosts applied.
ryan_oncall: update: error rate dropped from 42% -> 6% in 3m after the batch_size change. latency median +120ms on affected requests.
cs_ken: noticed increase in support cases: 2 premium customers reported function-call errors and partial outputs during the spike. tickets: #CS-8921, #CS-8924. keeping them notified.
maya_dev: i'm preparing a hotfix to serializer that normalizes tool output boundaries to preserve KV-prefix invariants. but that will require a small runtime patch + model-compat tests.
alana_sre: good. also propose a routing rule to bypass continuous-batching entirely when tool_call is set until we have a proven serializer. easier to reason about.
ryan_oncall: implemented quick rule to bypass batching if payload includes `"tool_call":true` OR `x-force-no-batch` header present. command: ```PATCH /config/routing {"route":"/v1/generate","conditions":{"tool_call":true},"action":"bypass_batching"}```
deploy-bot: routing change rolled out to all regions.
ryan_oncall: post-change metrics: 5xxs stable at ~1.6%, overall QPS slightly lower but steady. customers still on open tickets are being updated by CS.
eng_lead_oli: can we quantify impact? need RPS affected, p95 latency delta, and revenue-class customers impacted for the postmortem.
cs_ken: from tickets: both impacted customers on Dedicated plans; one had a 30s timeout, one received truncated tool responses. will attach transcripts.
maya_dev: shipping serializer v2.1 that preserves token alignment and adds a deterministic padding step to keep key prefixes stable. running integration tests now.
alana_sre: once v2.1 passes, plan to re-enable continuous-batching for tool_call requests behind a canary with conservative batch limits and KV cache warming. also add an automated guard: if batch composition fails 3x in 5m, fallback to bypass mode automatically.
ryan_oncall: creating incident doc and timeline. I'll hand off to night oncall in 30m. summary for handoff: root cause = structured-tool-output change causing batch boundary instability -> cache prefix mismatches -> batch failures and evictions. mitigation = emergency bypass of batching for tool_call + reduced batch_size to 1 earlier, routing rule to bypass; ongoing = serializer hotfix + controlled re-enable.
ryan_oncall: handing off to @night_oncall at 1778756500. keep alerts unmuted.
night_oncall: acked, taking over. will monitor error-rate and customer queue.
incident-bot: Incident status -> RESOLVED (mitigation applied, metrics within normal range). timeline and runbook: https://wiki.internal/incidents/1778754321. postmortem requested by eng_lead_oli.
eng_lead_oli: great coordination. include action items: serializer stabilization, improved preflight tests for toolcall+batching, and an automated circuit to detect batch fragmentation.
cs_ken: will follow up with impacted customers with root cause summary and credits where appropriate.
maya_dev: will open PR for v2.1 and link test results.
ryan_oncall: closing the pager thread — if anyone sees a regression, ping here or escalate to PD. :thumbsup:
__notes: This document is a synthetic Slack thread for the incidents channel describing a KV cache/continuous-batching regression caused by structured tool-call output changes. All fields are strings or list of strings as required.
